about.title:
Rooted in the land,

trusted by the herd.
about.lead: We don't just move bales. We protect the health of every animal that depends on them.
about.p1: Prairies Fodder Trading is a Dubai-based supplier of premium animal fodder. We bring together carefully sourced hay, grasses and feed from trusted growers across the world's finest forage regions — and deliver them, consistently and on time, to the stables and farms that depend on them.
about.p2: Every batch is selected for nutrition, freshness and consistency, lab-tested on intake, and traceable from field to gate — because the animals you care for deserve nothing less.
about.quote: The best feed isn't found. It's selected, tested, and protected — bale by bale.

products.title: Premium feed, graded and tested.
products.intro: From high-protein hay for performance horses to bulk roughage for livestock and camels — sourced clean, baled tight, every grade documented.

alfalfa.desc: High-protein, leafy and energy-rich — the gold standard for performance horses and dairy herds.

rhodes.desc: The Gulf's everyday roughage — clean, palatable and low-dust, ideal for camels and general livestock.

timothy.desc: Low-protein, high-fibre forage supporting steady digestion — a stable favourite for mature horses.

oatBarley.desc: Whole-grain energy feed and hay — a reliable source of fibre and condition for working animals.

strawBran.desc: Cost-effective bedding and fibre, plus protein-rich bran — versatile staples for any farm.

compound.desc: Balanced, formulated pellets and mixes for poultry and livestock — consistent nutrition in every bag.

journey.title: Five steps. Full traceability.
journey.intro: Every bale we deliver can be traced back to the field it came from — and through every check along the way.

source.title: Source & select
source.desc: We hand-pick growers across the world's best forage regions.

test.title: Lab test & grade
test.desc: Protein, moisture and cleanliness verified on intake.

compress.title: Compress & bale
compress.desc: Double-compressed and sealed for freshness and freight.

store.title: Store & protect
store.desc: Climate-aware warehousing keeps every batch in condition.

deliver.title: Deliver to your gate
deliver.desc: On-time delivery across the Emirates and the Gulf.

origins.title: The world's best fields, one trusted hub.
origins.intro: Drought, season, freight — single-origin supply is fragile. We hold relationships across multiple continents so your feed keeps arriving, whatever the market does.

serve.title: Built for every animal you raise.
serve.intro: One supplier for the whole operation — matched forage for the needs of each animal.

quality.title: Lab-tested quality
quality.desc: Moisture, protein and cleanliness checked on every intake.

traceability.title: Full traceability
traceability.desc: Every bale traceable back to the field it was grown in.

storage.title: Climate-aware storage
storage.desc: Covered warehousing built for Gulf conditions.

logistics.title: GCC-wide logistics
logistics.desc: Reliable delivery network across the Emirates and beyond.
